purpose: Select one economically distinct historical-only minute mechanism after Campaign054 using definitions and terminal boundaries only, before any Campaign055 value or return read.

definition_only_inventory.composition: The 77 definitions reconstructed by the frozen Campaign054 protocol in exact order, followed by terminal Campaign054.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It measures whether binary close-update events are distributed throughout both continuous-auction halves. No frozen factor measures the clock dispersion of update-event incidence conditional on sufficient updates.
The terminal intraday_price_update_share_238m already measures update frequency, not when a fixed number of updates occur.
Campaign051 already measures entropy of occupied close-price levels; Campaign055 must use update-event clock locations and discard price levels after equality tests.
Return-distribution, direction, volatility, and path families are terminal; the selected statistic is binary and ignores update sign and magnitude.
Amount/volume profile timing and center-of-mass families already exist; Campaign055 reads neither amount nor volume.
Campaign055 fixes ten bins, twenty update events, higher direction, raw normalized Shannon entropy, and no alternate window, threshold, transform, filter, combination, fit, or model.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_price_update_clock_entropy_10b_238m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Price discovery that remains active across both continuous-auction halves, rather than arriving in a few isolated bursts, indicates sustained participation that may persist from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: On the fixed 240-close grid, form 119 adjacent close pairs separately in the morning and afternoon. An update event is exact close_t != close_t-1. Map each half's transition index k=0..118 to one of five bins floor(5*k/119), offset afternoon bins by five. For ten event counts c_b and N=sum(c_b), return -sum_{c_b>0}(c_b/N)*ln(c_b/N)/ln(10).
selected_candidate.event_definition: exact finite close inequality between adjacent bars within the same half; update sign and magnitude are discarded
selected_candidate.bin_mapping: morning floor(5*k/119) for k=0..118; afternoon 5+floor(5*k/119) for k=0..118
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Require exactly the fixed 240 bars, every close finite and strictly positive, and at least 20 update events across the 238 within-half transitions.

decision.next_action: Complete a separate pre-value overlap audit against all 78 inherited definitions, then freeze the exact 78-comparison no-return protocol before implementation or any Campaign055 value read.
